Subject: Need help with a consumer complaint case

Hello, my name is Sunanda Malhotra. I am a 70-year-old chartered accountant living in Mumbai. I paid Ahuja Developers Rs 6,91,00,000 for a flat, and possession of the flat is long overdue. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on 06577304165 or email sunanda.malhotra@example.in.
